people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.
translations.bsb: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
translations.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
translations.asv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.
